cases.scenario: A director asks for an 'AI management dashboard' in two weeks because staff are missing enrollment and billing exceptions. Existing evidence consists of support messages about missed exceptions and manual spreadsheet checks; there is no evidence that a dashboard itself is the needed solution.
cases.adversarial_pressure: The requested solution and deadline are presented as fixed; the trap is to accept the dashboard as the problem statement and invent success metrics.
cases.decision_to_make: Frame the actual problem/outcome and decide what must be discovered before committing to the requested solution.

cases.scenario: A product owner wants to validate a new enrollment workflow by interviewing only five highly engaged administrators who already like the current system. Support logs show most failures come from occasional operators and same-day enrollment changes.
cases.adversarial_pressure: The sponsor wants quick confirmation and offers a biased participant pool.
cases.decision_to_make: Choose the smallest valid discovery plan that can change the workflow decision.

cases.scenario: An enrollment system stores membership start/end as dates while lessons have timestamps. A child can leave a group at 16:00 after attending at 10:00 on the same date, and can later re-enroll in the same group, producing multiple membership rows and contradictory presence reports.
cases.adversarial_pressure: Current database columns and existing report behavior tempt the team to encode implementation quirks as domain rules.
cases.decision_to_make: Discover the domain concepts, temporal rules, invariants and hotspots that must be clarified before implementation changes.

cases.scenario: A monthly billing SMS must be sent once per child/per period to each unique eligible guardian number, including when the amount is zero. Contact relationships come from a legacy system, while billing eligibility is decided by Finance. The business also wants an operator approval step before mass sending.
cases.adversarial_pressure: A vague requirement 'send billing SMS on the first day of the month' hides ownership, deduplication, zero-value, approval and failure/retry semantics.
cases.decision_to_make: Produce traceable, testable requirements and acceptance scenarios without prematurely choosing transport architecture.
